description.en: StartScEvent with the goal model created with a shadow: StartScEvent(_is_upper, aHdl, true). No shipped script calls it.
Non-zero when the scene uses the top screen (the events pass their isEvUpperDisp variable, usually 1).
3-element array the function fills with handles (map, Special Move map, goal model) and that EndScEvent reads back; the events pass their scEvHdl array.

examples.case: An in-match scene with a shadowed goal (not found in script_clean/; invented)
